slides.texte_overlay:
How to Become
Unrecognizable by Next Year
(Part 2)

1) CIRCLE
• Spend time with people
ahead of you
• Leave the group chats
that drain you
• Call your parents every week
• Make one friend outside work

2) STYLE
• Haircut every 3-4 weeks
• Fewer clothes, better fit
• Iron tomorrow's shirt tonight
• Keep your shoes clean

3) MIND
• Read 20 pages a day
• Learn one new thing a day
• Write 3 lines every night
• Sit 10 minutes
without your phone
slides.texte_sophia:
3) MIND
• Read 20 pages a day
• Learn one new thing a day
on the Sophia app
• Write 3 lines every night
• Sit 10 minutes
without your phone

slides.texte_overlay:
4) HOME
• Make your bed every morning
• Clean up before you sleep
• Good light, no clutter
• A desk only for work

5) SKILLS
• Cook 5 real meals
• Change a tire yourself
• 15 minutes of a language
every day
• Speak in front of people
